definitions.gloss: North Africa; northern part of the African continent
definitions.explanation: The northern part of the African continent, bordering the Mediterranean Sea. It includes countries such as Egypt, Libya, Tunisia, Algeria, and Morocco.

examples.english: I tried some North African food.

examples.english: The Sahara Desert occupies most of North Africa.

notes:
The Mediterranean-facing northern portion of Africa, separated from the rest of the continent by the Sahara Desert.
